messages:
deploybot: preflight eval completed for release r2026.03.21-candidate. Summary: 3 user-visible regressions detected across the finance prompt suite (out of 120 checks). Gate: HOLD. See quick report: https://ci.internal/reports/1712349999

sara: can someone paste the failing prompt ids and short examples?

deploybot: failing ids: [TX-77, TX-81, FR-309]. Deltas vs baseline v4.1: F1 -0.047, precision -0.039, currency_format_errors +0.018. Examples below:

```
TX-77 baseline: "Your refund: $1,240.00"
TX-77 candidate: "Refund amount: 124000"  <-- misplaced decimal / units

FR-309 baseline: "Invoice total: EUR 3,200.50"
FR-309 candidate: "Invoice total 3200.5"  <-- lost currency symbol and spacing
```

mike: looks like numerical formatting and a couple hallucinations. Is this isolated to finance?

jen-qa: confirmed: 2 hallucinations in tax extraction (high severity) + 1 formatting loss. I uploaded diffs to artifact (ci://artifacts/1712349999/diffs).

nina-ops: what's the current gating rule? I recall we required >=2 user-visible regressions to block, but want to confirm.

deploybot: gate policy: hold if USER_VISIBLE_regressions >= 2 OR global_quality_delta >= 0.035. Current USER_VISIBLE=3, global F1 delta=0.047 -> HOLD triggered.

sara: product ask: can we do a route-level pin for finance endpoints to v4.1 and let other routes continue on candidate? That would reduce customer impact.

pat: change window closes at 16:50 PT. If we pin, ops needs a scheduled time and a rollback playbook. If delaying until tomorrow, we also need to update release notes.

mike: two possible tracks:
1) Pin finance-route to v4.1 for 24 hours, continue canary elsewhere. Fast, targeted. Needs product approval + ops ack.
2) Full rollback of the candidate and run a targeted fix in model prompts or tokenizer sync. Slower but avoids split complexity.

sara: I'm leaning to option 1. Less customer surface-area. @maria-product can you sign off?

j en-qa: I'll run a focused 5k-sample rerun on finance prompts to reduce flakiness risk and confirm counts. ETA ~15m.

deploybot: created ticket INF-5599 and a canary-split stub for finance route. Note: route pin action requires explicit product approval message in-thread to proceed.

maria-product: reviewed snippets and artifacts. The hallucinations on tax fields are unacceptable. Approve: pin finance-route to v4.1 for 24h while ML/QA investigate. :white_check_mark:

nina-ops: ops acked. Scheduling pin at 16:30 PT and enabling extra monitoring (error-rate, latency, token-cost). Rollback trigger: error-rate > 2x baseline OR latency > +30% for >5m. Rollback playbook: https://runbooks/internal/finance-pin-rollback

pat: I'll add a changelog entry: "Finance endpoints temporarily pinned to v4.1 due to detected regressions in tax extraction prompts; investigation underway." Also notify customers on status page if we hit degraded user metrics.

jen-qa: rerun complete: focused 5k confirms same 3 user-visible regressions. Metrics: F1 delta -0.044, hallucination_count +25. Uploaded detailed diffs to INF-5599.

deploybot: pin action executed at 16:30 PT. Canary status: finance-route -> pinned(v4.1); other routes continue at candidate v4.2 (20% US / 10% EU). Ticket INF-5599 updated with timestamps.

mike: ML, please prioritize triage: could this be quantization/kv-cache mismatch? Share hypotheses here when you have them.

jen-qa: initial hypothesis from sample diffs: tokenizer normalization differences + small prompt-preprocessing change in v4.2. ML to run tokenizer-consistency check now.

maria-product: thanks all. Keep me posted if we need to widen the pin or do a full rollback.

nina-ops: monitoring steady at +6m after pin. No alarm triggers yet.

sara: closing thread for now — will reopen if alarms or if ML requests broader action. Thanks everyone.

deploybot: thread closed (pin applied). Reply 'reopen' to reopen.
